findings.description: 19 instances of setTimeout-based waits (up to 400ms). Most egregious use of arbitrary delays in the test suite. High flakiness risk under CI CPU pressure.
findings.fix: Replace setTimeout waits with oneEvent() for hx-show/hx-after-show/hx-hide/hx-after-hide events, or await el.updateComplete for property changes.

findings.description: Uses 250ms setTimeout delay, likely waiting for debounced input. Flaky under CPU pressure.
findings.fix: Replace with vi.useFakeTimers() to advance time deterministically, or use oneEvent('hx-input').

findings.description: Uses 200ms setTimeout delay. Brittle timing dependency.
findings.fix: Replace with await el.updateComplete or oneEvent() for the specific state change being waited on.

findings.description: 9 instances of setTimeout(0) microtask yields. While less dangerous than long delays, these indicate missing proper Lit lifecycle waits.
findings.fix: Replace with await el.updateComplete after each mutation. If waiting for nested component updates, await the child's updateComplete too.

findings.description: 3 instances of setTimeout(0) microtask yields for tab panel updates.
findings.fix: Replace with await el.updateComplete to properly wait for Lit rendering.

findings.description: Uses setTimeout(50) for timing-sensitive test. Minor flakiness risk.
findings.fix: Replace with await el.updateComplete or oneEvent().
